text:
maria: Pushed v2p1-int4 to 5% for the long-docs slice (docs-longctx). Quick sanity: small quality regression on rerank + slight latency tail bump. tagging @kevin @sam for gating decision.

kevin: can you paste the delta numbers? rough is fine.

maria: baseline vs candidate (5%):
```
baseline:  exact_match 0.912, rerank_top1 0.882, p99_latency_ms 210
candidate: exact_match 0.904, rerank_top1 0.851, p99_latency_ms 232
delta: -0.88% exact_match, -3.45% rerank_top1, +22ms p99
```

sam: rerank drop is the one I'd worry about. which slices show it? any subset with more than 5% drop?

maria: it's concentrated on multi-document merges and code snippets: doc_merge and code_block slices. sample size small but signal consistent across three windows.

june: what's our current auto-fallback policy? I thought we used composite scoring + per-slice fallback.

kevin: current rules (prod):
```
composite_delta_pct: 1.0
slice_drop_pct: 2.0
p99_latency_ms_increase: 50
consecutive_windows: 3
```
Fallback triggers if composite_delta >= composite_delta_pct OR any slice_drop >= slice_drop_pct AND either latency penalty or sustained for consecutive_windows.

sam: Suggest tightening for longdocs: rerank is very important there. Propose: composite 0.6%, slice_drop 1.5% for docs-longctx specifically, and consecutive_windows=5. Also add kv_warmup_grace=2 windows because prefix cache can be cold during first rollout.

alex: Agree on kv_warmup_grace. Also recommend adding a toleration for latency-only blips if quality unchanged: if quality delta < 0.3% but p99 + <100ms, don't fallback.

maria: Draft policy snippet I'm proposing for this rollout: 
```
fallback_policy:
  default:
    composite_delta_pct: 1.0
    slice_drop_pct: 2.0
    p99_latency_ms_increase: 50
    consecutive_windows: 3
  overrides:
    docs-longctx:
      composite_delta_pct: 0.6
      slice_drop_pct: 1.5
      consecutive_windows: 5
      kv_warmup_grace: 2
  latency_tolerance_if_quality_ok:
    quality_delta_pct_threshold: 0.3
    max_p99_ms_increase: 100
```

kevin: that looks reasonable. we should also gate on absolute sample counts to avoid noisy slices. min_samples: 500 per window for slice evaluation.

sam: +1 to min_samples. Also add a soft rollback notification to #eng-oncall with the diff summary and the top offending slices before auto-fallback executes.

maria: will update the policy and roll back to 0% if rule trips. For now I'll pause promotion to 0->10% and run a 30k sample shadow run with rerank golden comparison.

deploy-bot: shadow-run started: run_id=sr-20260323-21, sample_size=30000, target_variant=v2p1-int4, baseline=v2p1-fp16

june: thanks. once shadow run completes, post the per-slice heatmap and the composite metric breakdown. If rerank_top1 drop persists >2% on doc_merge, we'll auto-fallback.

maria: noted. will share results in this thread. :eyes:

kevin: one more ask — add a confusion-matrix style quick eval for code_block slice (we've had hallucination regressions there before). if any hallucination rate increases >1% absolute, emergency rollback.

maria: adding that check to the smoke suite.

alex: good catch. also add a post-mortem checklist entry to capture whether quantization config (per-layer scale) differs from previous rollout. sometimes tiny layer-scale changes cause rerank drift.

maria: thanks team. pausing traffic promotion. will post shadow results (sr-20260323-21) here in ~4 hours.

sam: sounds good. keep the thresholds conservative for longdocs.

kevin: +1

maria: (later) shadow-run done — attaching short summary:
```
shadow sr-20260323-21 summary:
sample 30k, slices with >=500 samples: doc_merge (4k), code_block (1.2k), short_answers (18k)
composite_delta: -0.72%
doc_merge rerank_top1: -3.8%
code_block hallucination_rate: +0.9% (baseline 0.6 -> candidate 1.5)
p99 latency: +24ms
```

june: code_block hallucination +0.9% is concerning (close to 1% emergency threshold kevin asked for). doc_merge rerank -3.8% definitely fails our docs-longctx override slice_drop_pct.

maria: Given policy, I'm triggering auto-fallback to baseline and marking v2p1-int4 rollout as failed. Rolling back to v2p1-fp16 now.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated: rollback_id=rb-20260323-77, reason=docs-longctx rerank & code_block hallucination

kevin: good call. please file a short postmortem with root-cause hypotheses (quant layer scale vs attention kernel) and list tests to run before next attempt (per-layer sensitivity, code_block hallucination unit tests).

maria: filing postmortem now and scheduling a focused repro run for code_block and doc_merge on quant ablations.

sam: let's also add a canary that warms kv for 1M tokens before traffic shift so warmup doesn't confound metrics next time.

maria: adding that to rollout checklist. thanks everyone.
